rebuttal_or_critique: The consensus to hold the repo rate at 6.50% is appropriate, as monetary policy must distinguish between transient food-price shocks and generalized inflation. With core inflation at 4.90%, the underlying demand-side pressure remains contained. While I maintain that the 'withdrawal of accommodation' stance should be temporary and data-dependent to avoid stifling the 7.80% GVA growth, I acknowledge the committee's need to anchor inflation expectations given the 7.44% headline print. I support the current collective path to preserve macroeconomic stability without imposing unnecessary costs on the real economy.
